products.title: Saanjh Kurta Set
products.subtitle: Mulmul cotton, 3-piece
products.description: Hand-block-printed mulmul kurta with cigarette pants and a soft dupatta. Cut for movement; finished by hand at the hem.
products.story: It started with the mulmul. Featherweight, breathable, drapes like nothing else. Saanjh is our everyday answer to summer.

fabric.wash_care: Hand wash cold, line dry in shade

products.title: Roohi 3-Piece Set
products.subtitle: Cotton-modal, wide-leg
products.description: A workhorse 3-piece in our breathable cotton-modal blend. Wide-leg pants, structured kurta, soft dupatta.
products.story: Roohi was seventeen swatches in the making. The final cotton-modal blend drapes, breathes, and holds shape through a long day.

products.title: Amba Co-ord Set
products.subtitle: Twill viscose, cropped
products.description: A modern co-ord in twill viscose — relaxed silhouette, hidden side pockets, mother-of-pearl buttons.
products.story: A two-piece for the in-between days. The twill drapes around the body but holds a shape.

products.title: Noor Kurta Set
products.subtitle: Cotton voile, chikankari-inspired
products.description: Featherweight cotton voile with hand-finished embroidery at the neckline and cuffs.
products.story: Voile so light it almost forgets to be there. Lined where it matters, embroidered where it doesn't.

products.title: Bageecha Co-ord
products.subtitle: Block-print cotton
products.description: A garden in block print. Soft cotton, hand-knotted ties at the waist.
products.story: Bageecha means garden. The print was carved into a wooden block before it was printed onto the cotton.

products.title: Mehfil Kurta Set
products.subtitle: Silk-cotton dobby
products.description: A festive kurta woven in silk-cotton dobby — subtle texture, soft sheen.
products.story: Mehfil is the one we save for the gatherings. Silk-cotton dobby holds light differently than anything else in our drop.

reviews.name: Ananya M.
reviews.body: The mulmul is so soft, exactly like the photos. Wore it to a Diwali brunch — got asked five times where it's from.

reviews.name: Priya R.
reviews.body: Finally a brand that tells you the GSM. The fabric is breathable, the fit is honest. Exchange was painless when I wanted L.

reviews.name: Sneha K.
reviews.body: Beautiful kurta, the print is exactly as shown. Slightly snug at bust — sizing up worked perfectly. Will repurchase.

reviews.name: Aarti S.
reviews.body: Photographer kept commenting on how well-made it is. The hem stitching is impeccable.

reviews.name: Ritika J.
reviews.body: Easy 5 stars. The fit guide is spot on — measure once, buy with confidence.

reviews.name: Meera V.
reviews.body: Comfortable for long workdays. Wish the dupatta were a touch longer but the kurta itself is wonderful.
